from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single provided paper regarding its citation behavior."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper as named in the text")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of the OTHER provided papers that this paper cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
